name: Reader
description: E-reader for project material — import PDFs, web pages, and files; read in a clean paragraph view; originals kept as archival copy. TTS, annotations, and memory promotion arrive in later milestones.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: READER_SECRETS_FILE
env_vars.description: Optional path to a KEY=VALUE secrets file loaded after $CROW_HOME/env/reader.env (process.env still wins)

env_vars.name: READER_EMBED_URL
env_vars.description: OpenAI-style embeddings base URL for semantic search (POSTs to <url>/embeddings); unset disables semantic search, FTS still works

env_vars.name: GOOGLE_TOKEN_FILE
env_vars.description: Path to a Google OAuth2 authorized_user JSON; unset hides Drive import and Doc export

env_vars.name: READER_EXPORT_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID
env_vars.description: Drive folder id for Google Doc exports

env_vars.name: READER_UV_BIN
env_vars.description: Path to the uv binary for the Python extractor (default: uv on PATH)

env_vars.name: READER_MAX_UPLOAD_MB
env_vars.description: Upload size cap in MB, also caps URL-import downloads (default 50)

env_vars.name: READER_AUDIO_CACHE_MB
env_vars.description: TTS audio cache cap in MB, used from milestone 2 (default 2048)

env_vars.name: READER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
env_vars.description: Set to 1 to let URL import fetch private/loopback addresses (default: blocked, SSRF guard)

env_vars.name: READER_INGEST_ROOTS
env_vars.description: Colon-separated directory allowlist for crow_reader_ingest local paths (default: the user home directory)

notes: Milestone 1 ships import + Read view. TTS (gateway registry, timing-aware), quote-anchored annotations with crow memory promotion, pdf.js Original view, and Drive/Doc export land in later milestones per the design spec.
